name: Maruzen Showa Unyu Co., Ltd.
summary: Maruzen Showa Unyu Co., Ltd. engages in the logistics business in Japan and internationally. The company offers intermodal, overseas industrial plant, and international air transport logistics services; handling of import and export cargo, including import- and export-related paperwork and stevedoring; customs clearance services, authorized customs broker, and authorized warehouse operator; export packing services; and project planning, coordination, planning, management, on-site work and maintenance for moving factories, and production lines or large machinery engineering services.
